_note: Durable, stb-only alias layer: friendly meaning for each token id. Decoupled from the Stratos token definitions — editing names here changes nothing in the Stratos codebase. Export still emits the real ids.

--color-brand-50.label: Brand tint (lightest)
--color-brand-50.description: Faintest brand shade. Subtle backgrounds and hover fills.

--color-brand-100.label: Brand tint (very light)
--color-brand-100.description: Very light brand shade. Quiet surfaces, selected rows.

--color-brand-200.label: Brand tint (light)
--color-brand-200.description: Light brand shade. Soft fills and borders.

--color-brand-300.label: Brand tint
--color-brand-300.description: Light-mid brand shade. Borders, disabled accents.

--color-brand-400.label: Brand (soft)
--color-brand-400.description: Mid-light brand shade approaching the core color.

--color-brand-500.label: Brand core
--color-brand-500.description: The main brand color — anchor of the shade ramp.

--color-brand-600.label: Brand (strong)
--color-brand-600.description: Darker brand shade. Hover/active on brand surfaces.

--color-brand-700.label: Brand (stronger)
--color-brand-700.description: Strong brand shade for emphasis and pressed states.

--color-brand-900.label: Brand (darkest)
--color-brand-900.description: Darkest brand shade. Brand-tinted text on light surfaces.

--color-primary.label: Primary action color
--color-primary.description: Main interactive color. Primary buttons, links, focus rings, active states.

--color-success.label: Success color
--color-success.description: Positive / confirmation states. Success badges, valid inputs.

--color-warning.label: Warning color
--color-warning.description: Caution states. Warning badges and non-blocking alerts.

--color-danger.label: Error / danger color
--color-danger.description: Error and destructive states. This is the SEED color: the alert surface derives a light background and dark text from it so they stay readable. Do not use it directly as both background and text — same color on both has no contrast.

--nav-bg.label: Navigation background
--nav-bg.description: Background of the side navigation and app chrome.

--nav-text.label: Navigation text
--nav-text.description: Primary text and icons on the navigation background.

--nav-text-muted.label: Navigation muted text
--nav-text-muted.description: Secondary / inactive labels in the navigation.
